dratini-outrage.name: Outrage
dratini-outrage.description: Bond skill: rampages into a foe (Power 100, Attack).

dratini-dragon-pulse.name: Dragon Pulse
dratini-dragon-pulse.description: Bond skill: a shockwave from its mouth at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 85).

dratini-extreme-speed.name: Extreme Speed
dratini-extreme-speed.description: Bond skill: a blinding rush at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 60, Attack) that engages it.

dratini-dragon-blood.name: Dragon Blood
dratini-dragon-blood.description: Its Dragon moves deal 15% more damage.

dratini-shed-skin.name: Shed Skin
dratini-shed-skin.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

dratini-leer.name: Leer
dratini-leer.description: New skill: an intimidating glare leaves every adjacent foe Exposed for 2 turns.

dratini-slam.name: Slam
dratini-slam.description: New skill: slams its long body into an adjacent foe (Power 70).

dratini-constrictor.name: Constrictor
dratini-constrictor.description: Its free strikes on foes breaking away deal 25% more damage.

dratini-serpent-glide.name: Serpent Glide
dratini-serpent-glide.description: Steps away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

dratini-dragon-dance.name: Dragon Dance
dratini-dragon-dance.description: New skill: a mystic dance that makes it Focused for 1 turn and Hasted for 2 turns.

dratini-dragon-breath.name: Dragon Breath
dratini-dragon-breath.description: New skill: a draconic breath at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70), Paralysing it 1 turn.

dratini-crystal-orbs.name: Crystal Orbs
dratini-crystal-orbs.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 more turn.

dratini-mystic-aura.name: Mystic Aura
dratini-mystic-aura.description: Heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

dratini-dragon-rush.name: Dragon Rush
dratini-dragon-rush.description: New skill: charges a foe up to 2 hexes away with menace (Power 95) and engages it.

dratini-hurricane.name: Hurricane
dratini-hurricane.description: New skill: a raging wind at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 90).

dratini-battle-hunger.name: Battle Hunger
dratini-battle-hunger.description: Gains 1 Attack for this battle per knockout (max +3).

dratini-swift-serpent.name: Swift Serpent
dratini-swift-serpent.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

dratini-dragon-tail.name: Dragon Tail
dratini-dragon-tail.description: New skill: a sweeping tail blow (Power 85) that pushes the foe 2 hexes.

dratini-air-slash.name: Air Slash
dratini-air-slash.description: New skill: a cutting blade of air at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 90); Slows 1 turn.

dratini-multiscale.name: Multiscale
dratini-multiscale.description: Takes 25% less damage while at full HP.

dratini-wingbeat-gale.name: Wingbeat Gale
dratini-wingbeat-gale.description: Its pushes knock foes 1 hex farther: its huge wings stir up gales.

dratini-sea-incarnate.name: Incarnation of the Sea
dratini-sea-incarnate.description: Capstone. Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP; heals 20% of max HP on a knockout.

dratini-dragons-wrath.name: Dragon's Wrath
dratini-dragons-wrath.description: Capstone. Knockouts reset its skill cooldowns; deals 15% more damage (25% below half HP).
